LauncherHome and SettingsRoles passed in the runner's --home-role phase on the launcher flavor, class E on developer APKs with an unpackaged resident runtime (not distributable), one API 36 arm64 SDK emulator, at 2961bd9e and 9a1ca161 (pin 13c9857598); that is not B (distributable), I or D evidence. LauncherLibraryInstrumentedTest has no recorded run (MVP-53). RotationInstrumentedTest passed at 73b973a5 (pin 352d7a08) and 6dcdde34 (pin 40dbe96bd1) and was not run at 13c9857598. requirements.title: Standalone and HOME APKs from one source; offline shell; stock settings and recovery accessible
requirements.gate: B: four distribution APKs build at the current pin and scripts/verify-apks.mjs marks the releases distributable:true, which needs the release signer (A-06); then E: install both modes, open apps and return HOME repeatedly
requirements.remaining: No distribution APK build exists at the current pin (13c9857598). Developer APKs without the resident runtime were built there (hosted Android foundation runs 38118499272 at c0b19147 and 38131665152 at f87850fa, and development machines) and installed on one API 36 arm64 emulator at 2961bd9e and 9a1ca161, where LauncherHome and SettingsRoles (--home-role), LocalAgentOfflineApps, Shell and NoMockProduct passed: class E on developer APKs only. There is no distribution B build and no class I or D evidence. scripts/verify-apks.mjs passes a developer APK as a developer build; it marks a release distributable only when it is signed by the certificate in android/release-signer.json, which stays unset until A-06, and carries the packaged resident runtime and qualified speech. A distribution build also needs the reviewed embedding host. The MVP completion integration compiled both flavors' app and instrumentation Java (compile only, no APK) and added RendererRecoveryInstrumentedTest, which has not run.

requirements.title: Existing Eliza sign-in and pairing with an approved Alpha routing adapter and owner-scoped credentials
requirements.gate: E then R and D: ConnectionRoutesInstrumentedTest on a flag-off APK; then CLI-session expiry, reused-claim refusal, live self-revocation, account replacement and wrong-owner tests against the managed endpoint (A-02)
requirements.remaining: Production Android pairing is retired by design: a flag-off build admits only https://api.eliza.app and opens only eliza.app, cloud.eliza.app and accounts.google.com externally (ConnectionRoutes.java). A sign-in as a second Cloud account revokes the first account's key once before the new key is stored, unless Cloud returns the same key; the resident conversation history stays with the local owner, not the Cloud account (test/browser/cloud-account-replacement.production.spec.ts). Route and origin guards, self-revocation and account replacement have synthetic, host JVM and stubbed-bridge coverage only. ConnectionRoutesInstrumentedTest is compiled and has not run; no live Eliza Cloud revocation and no device run exist. The web build cannot sign in to or revoke Eliza Cloud.

requirements.title: Android-resident agent execution with hosted Qwen inference on Cerebras, honest offline state and reconnect/history restoration
requirements.gate: E then D: resident process restart and reconnect without duplicate messages or writes; no inference-available claim without provider health evidence
requirements.remaining: Emulator and device acceptance of restart, reconnect, Stop and history restoration; the resident process-kill classes run only in the hosted CI lane and have no recorded passing run. Resident failures are reported by kind in stream and JSON replies, a lost network shows a notice beside the composer and sends nothing, and a start failure offers a retry and local apps (flag-off specs with a stubbed bridge, class S). A flag-off build still admits a direct Cerebras key through configureProvider, which the resident instrumentation relies on (A-20); the Cloud branch is limited to cerebras and qwen-3.8-27b (LocalAgentProviderAdmissionTest, host JVM). Cloud agents have no cancel route or older-page history cursor, and the read after Stop matches by text and time because upstream history rows do not expose the client message ID.

requirements.title: Voice entry and cancellation with explicit microphone state and typing fallback
requirements.gate: Owner: voice send and route policy (MVP-01) and whether on-device speech is still required (A-24); then R: Cloud speech with a signed-in account, and D: physical audio, interruption and latency (A-10)
requirements.remaining: Flag-off builds use Eliza Cloud speech (P-07); no real Cloud transcription has been exercised. The send policy is one constant that keeps today's sending of ongoing Cloud turns until MVP-01 is decided; local-first speech with Cloud only by disclosed opt-in is the PRD wording, pending MVP-01. A Cloud reply with no speech says so, and voice timing marks are recorded but not yet in the Settings diagnostics export. On-device speech: functional acceptance failed on a physical arm64-v8a device (D); a rebuilt candidate on main (android/local-speech/requalification/candidate-20261009.json) passed on an arm64 emulator (E) and is not admitted, and x86_64 is not executed; whether on-device speech is still required is A-24. The voice, voice-revoke and voice-limit campaigns passed on both flavors at 6dcdde34 (round 7, pin 40dbe96bd1) and were not rerun at 13c9857598. Always-on listening and hardware invocation (MVP-52) are open and owner-gated.

requirements.title: Daily overview with real agenda, attention items and briefs
requirements.gate: R: real provider agenda and digests with loading, empty, stale and error states; then D
requirements.remaining: Agenda comes from on-device calendars only, and schedules are digest-only. A missed occurrence is recorded once and never replaces the last brief. The Home cards name their source and when it was read, an overdue event no longer hides the next one, a stale Inbox card shows a dash with no time, and the latest retained brief has its own card, with synthetic provider data only. Flag-off specs cover resident schedule creation, pause and revoke and the phone sources with consent. No real scheduled digest, native delivery or device calendar read is behind the cards (MVP-19). npm run agent:test-digest-restart passed at 352d7a08 and again at 40dbe96bd1 (host runtime, synthetic model) and was not run at 13c9857598; its lane (.github/workflows/digest-restart.yml) is dispatch-only and has not been dispatched.
